Exact stream selections take priority. Otherwise, source codecs restrict available streams; unavailable choices fail. Compatibility uses H.264 and AAC when codecs are automatic. Device decoders uses reported video codec support, with H.264 as a fallback if unavailable; profiles and playback are not guaranteed. Explicit codec choices override that policy. Lowest quality prefers lower resolution, bitrate, and frame rate. Container changes remux without converting codecs. Audio output format can convert the selected source; Original keeps its codec.

Fields: res, fps, br, size, vcodec, acodec, channels, ext, hdr, height, width, tbr, vbr, abr, filesize, fs_approx, codec, vext, aext. Put + before a field to prefer lower values. First field has priority.
Enter 1 to 10 supported fields separated by commas.

Audio captions can be saved separately in every audio format. Embedding requires M4A audio. ASS embedding requires MKV video; WebM embedding requires VTT. LRC is available as a separate file. Translated tracks are provided by the source and may be inaccurate.

Use black or white surfaces with stronger text, icons, outlines, and adjusted accents. Your chosen theme is kept for when this is off. Disabled controls remain dim; images, website pages, and content previews keep their own colors.
Starter translations are available for review. Some text remains in English.

Choose up to eight exact audio tracks. Multiple tracks use MKV. A combined video keeps its included audio and adds the chosen tracks. An empty selection uses Automatic for a video-only stream. Changes apply on Done.
Uses a video-only source stream and clears audio choices. If none is available, the download fails. Choosing a combined video stream restores its included audio.
Source streams changed. Fetch the link again and review the stream selections.
One download is the default. Two can use more memory and battery. Reducing the limit lets running downloads finish before another starts.

Choosing a template fills the current download controls. Later edits take priority. Clearing it removes its raw format selection and keeps the other current choices. Saved requests keep their accepted settings.
Create or import a command template in Settings.
The template is missing, changed, invalid, or incompatible with these choices. Review its supported options or clear its selection.
Review the command template or clear its selection, then try again. It may be missing, changed, unsupported, or select an incompatible media type.

Keep up to 20 templates of supported download options. They fill the download controls; later edits take priority. Use the link box for links. Shell commands, credentials, custom output paths, regex filters, and format selections for several media files are unsupported. Imports are previewed before applying.
Could not read or save templates. Check the file, supported options, unique names, and 20-template limit.
Add %1$d templates and update %2$d matching templates? Existing templates remain unchanged until you import.

Export all records, or select records first. JSON includes source links, names, metadata, dates, and file references. Files and access permissions are not included. File documents support 2,000 records and 1 MiB; clipboard text supports 256 KiB.

Imported paths do not grant access. Choose a matching file, or decide how unavailable records should be imported.
This document adds or updates %1$d command templates in Settings. It does not add History or start downloads.
Could not transfer History. Check the document format, size, clipboard, or file access. Your existing records are unchanged.

Save up to 20 ordered ranges without overlaps. Acqua downloads the source once, then cuts each clip locally and adjusts captions and chapters. Video cuts are re-encoded as H.264, or VP9 for WebM. Audio streams are copied. This needs space for the source and clips.

Shift all captions forward with positive seconds or backward with negative seconds. Use 100% for unchanged speed. Times are scaled, shifted, then trimmed to each clip and moved to its beginning. Edited timelines use SRT when Original is selected. A clip with no matching cues has no caption file.
Use a shift from -3600 to 3600 seconds and a scale from 50% to 200%.
Could not produce the selected clips or captions. Review the ranges, source duration, and caption choices.
Keep up to 20 named cookie snapshots and their browser user agents for authorized downloads. Transfers use separate saved cookies. The browser shares one sign-in and website storage.
I authorize these cookies for this website and its subdomains.

Visit the page and sign in through Acqua first. Save or refresh captures the browser cookies available for that page and its actual user agent. Supported WebViews retain cookie attributes. Older captures use the observed host and path and expire locally after 24 hours. Partitioned cookies are retained for export but excluded from transfers. Queued downloads retain their accepted snapshot after refresh.

Choose a saved session before fetching media. Changing it clears the current preview. Named sessions stay within their authorized website and never fall back to another account. Current browser uses the existing public-first behavior. Refreshing a session requires selecting it again for new downloads.
Enable browser sessions in Settings to use a saved session.
This export contains sign-in cookies and the browser user agent in an unencrypted JSON document. Anyone with the cookies may be able to access the signed-in account. Choose where to keep it.
New transfers and queued retries cannot use a removed session. Removing all saved sessions also erases their saved authorizations. Browser sign-in and downloaded files remain.
Could not save, refresh, or export this session. Check its name, visited page, available cookies, and file access.
The saved session is missing, expired, refreshed, disabled, or outside its authorized website. Review it in Settings, then fetch the link again.
Choose a folder for each media type. Custom folders use the selected location directly; the Downloads subfolder and media categories apply to the default location.
Folder unavailable. Choose a writable folder again.
Custom folders only. New files go inside Acqua hidden with a .nomedia marker. Some galleries ignore it. Files remain visible to file managers and are not encrypted.
